source_text.body:
Build verified paper corpora on any scientific topic
PaperRaven is a machine assistant run with Claude Code that searches and surveys scientific literature, building a topic-bounded, verified corpus of papers.
·
Nov 12, 2026
Done with
CC
Claude Code
What they did
Aaron Clauset announced PaperRaven, a tool that runs through Claude Code. It acts as a machine assistant for searching and surveying scientific literature. Given a scientific topic, it builds a corpus of papers that stays within the topic and has been verified. The post doesn't describe the mechanics, such as the search steps, the verification method, or where a person steps in.
How it went
The post is only an announcement. It states no results, numbers, or limitations. The linked project page may have the details.
Try it yourself
with
Claude Code
Copy prompt
Build a verified corpus of papers on [scientific topic], limited to [scope, date range, subtopics]. Search [sources like arXiv, PubMed, Semantic Scholar], confirm each paper exists and matches the topic, and save a file with title, authors, year, link and a one-line relevance note. Stop when you have about [number] verified papers, and list any you could not verify separately.
Original source: https://bsky.app/profile/aaronclauset.bsky.social/post/3n24tfuhgbc2i
